What developers can learn from these failures

Observed barriers and reviewable improvements. Generated tests, harness setup and model errors can all contribute; these are not proven defects in every library.

1. Give inputs precise roles and formats

Thumbnailator B2: tests treated thumbnail.png as a directory and appended another filename. mir_eval B2: a ragged time-series reader tried to parse timestamp as a number; file-reader tests referenced missing paths.

Improve: distinguish input_file, output_file and output_dir; show an actual valid data row; state header, delimiter, units and ownership rules. Execute examples against checked-in fixtures.

2. Make the public entry point unambiguous

Thumbnailator B2: Configurations.clear() and FileImageSink.createOutputStream(File) were rejected as non-public. RDPro: semantic review reduced validated-surface generated-README acceptance from 71 to 69.

Improve: publish qualified names, receivers, constructors and language-aware visibility. Link examples to the exact symbol. Verify the intended target call; exit code alone can accept the wrong operation.

3. Describe dependency capabilities explicitly

tslearn B2: 13 setup/import failures remained, including missing keras and tensorflow. Documentation cannot install missing runtime dependencies.

Improve: map optional feature groups to dependencies and tested versions; provide an import/feature preflight. Report unavailable capabilities separately from snippet mistakes. An inventory does not prove every import works.

4. Give examples meaningful correctness checks

mir_eval B2: cemgil expected a score near 1 but obtained 0; hierarchy expected 8 plotted patches but found 0. These require semantic inspection before attributing the cause.

Thumbnailator: assertions-enabled replay accepts fewer snippets than native reporting. Improve: enable assertions or use always-on checks; verify units, values, dimensions, side effects and target calls rather than only “did not crash.”

5. Test documentation with a fresh reader

RDPro: on 73 validated undocumented APIs, recorded semantic zero-fix acceptance rose from 9 to 32; on 88 shared documented APIs, it stayed 37 to 37. Coverage and correctness are different problems.

Improve: prioritize missing usage contracts, then test them with fresh agents. Keep repair-time checks separate from fresh B2 tests. Report regressions as well as recoveries.

6. Design automation for interruption and review

AIDEAL: MDAnalysis's legacy waiter observes a superseded prerequisite; tslearn recovery initially could not locate its matching environment inventory.

Improve: define terminal dependency states, single-writer locks, immutable input identities, durable phase checkpoints and failure categories. Queue suggested changes with evidence and an acceptance check. Validate proposed library changes before claiming improvement.

MDAnalysis is prospective evidence. Its YAML supplies PSF+DCD topology/trajectory data, PDB, GRO and XTC fixtures, plus a Universe/AtomGroup/trajectory preamble. Check each API's constructor inputs, selections, units and mutation/reset behavior. The full1032 static audit passed; runtime preflight and API outcomes are separate checks.
